svg.title: One-shot
svg.desc: Command: read <url> < script.js, What it does: Load a page in a scratch tab, run the script (or print the HTML when it's empty) and close the tab. --cookie NAME exits 3 when signed out; --until, --wait.; Command: fetch <url>, What it does: GET a URL with the browser's session, from a page on the same site (--from, default /robots.txt).; Command: download <url> <file>, What it does: Download with the session, replacing <file> once complete.; Command: keep-signed-in [site…], What it does: Visit the sites marked keepSignedIn and report whether each is still signed in. Naming sites marks them and installs the launch agent that visits every 10 minutes; --off unmarks them. Exits 3 when any is signed out, otherwise 4 when any couldn't be checked. See sites.md.
